title: The Rewind: Dare to Be Great II
summary:
One of the most important lessons of investing is that risk avoidance is not a good
idea. My partner, Sheldon Stone, says that if you have
no defaults in your high-year-bond portfolio, you're probably not taking enough risk. You want to take risk
up to the point where it's prudent, not much over that line.
